title: Custom Agent Management Is Insane
description: Custom agent management is insane. Spin up a team of agents from your phone. Each one has a role, a memory, and a cron schedule. They coordinate without you touching anything. This is what the agentic workflow actually looks like when it is running. #ClaudeCode #AIAgents #cortextOS #AgentArchitects #AIAutomation
